prompt: Build a modular Distributed Database Query Optimizer in C# structured into: (1) SQL Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) Parser, (2) Cost-Based Optimization Engine evaluating join order permutations, and (3) Execution Plan Generator producing physical operator trees.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Parser Score: 0-5 (Evaluates syntax tree generation and grammar rules)
Module 2 Optimizer Score: 0-5 (Evaluates cost estimation formulas and join reordering)
Module 3 Generator Score: 0-5 (Evaluates physical operator pipeline construction)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates query planning correctness and efficiency)
